blocks.text: Screengrab from Asean 2026 Ph / Facebook. MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) and the Republic of Korea (ROK) are looking to expand cooperation in artificial intelligence (AI) and cultural and creative industries, as both sides seek to strengthen their strategic partnership. This, as the 27th Asean-ROK Summit commenced on Monday as part of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits hosted by the Philippines in Manila. In his opening remarks as one of the co-chairs, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said the two sides’ partnership had become increasingly relevant amid strategic uncertainty, rapid technological change, and […]...
